verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a business communications platform, since self-hostable phone systems exist. The evidence describes only a vendor-hosted SaaS (production API at api.quo.com, app across iOS/Android/desktop/web, subscription pricing) and never mentions a self-hosted or on-premises deployment option. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
